s: a case; a suitcase or briefcase
Koffer.et: From Late Middle High German koffer, from Middle Dutch coffer, from Old French cofre.
Borrowed from Bavarian Koffer. Originally a Rotwelsch term. Borrowed from Yiddish כּפֿר (kafer, “farmer”), from Hebrew כְּפָר (kəp̄ār, “village”).

s: boot, trunk (luggage storage compartment of a car)
Das Schloss meines Kofferraumes ist defekt.
The lock of my trunk is defective.

Koffein.et: From earlier Kaffein, changed under influence of Latin coffē̆a.

s: trunklid, decklid (The lid of the trunk of a car.)
